segments.name: online game
segments.description: Develops and publishes online games such as Ragnarok Online for players, earning micro-transactions, subscriptions, royalties and license fees.
segments.evidence: The online game segment consists of Micro-transaction and subscription revenue, which is operated by us, and Royalties and license fee.

segments.name: mobile game
segments.description: Publishes mobile games, including Ragnarok titles, for players in Asia, the Americas and Europe, earning micro-transactions and royalties.
segments.evidence: The mobile game segment consists of Micro-transaction, which is operated by us, and Royalties and license fee.

segments.name: others
segments.description: Remaining operations outside the two game segments, including character based merchandise, animation and website development and operation services for third parties.
segments.evidence: The remainder of our operation is categorized as "others."

revenueModel.text: Players pay micro-transactions inside games we operate; third-party licensees pay royalties and license fees where they operate the games.
revenueModel.evidence: In markets where we or our subsidiary operate Ragnarok Online, our revenues are generated through micro-transaction revenue, and in markets where a third-party licensee operates the game, our revenues are generated through royalties or licensing fees.
